body.statement: When \(K=1\), \(\delta=0\), \(q_{11}=q_{21}=1\), and \(\omega_1=1\), the period-two no-prior-exposure controlled challenge risk in each arm obeys \(b_{2a1}\leq\rho_{2a}(x,\omega)\leq b_{1a1}+b_{2a1}\), the risk inclusion used in the proof of Theorem 1 of Janvin and Stensrud (2025).
body.justification: The no-priming endpoint \(\delta=0\) checks that the expanded history construction preserves the standard one-pathogen survivor-selection geometry.
body.gap: This is a required calibration to Janvin and Stensrud (2025), not a claimed novelty.
body.consumer: Readers can verify the new program against the established one-pathogen proof boundary before using variant margins.
